inputs.units: cm, cm^-3, V, cm^2/(V s), cm^-3 s^-1; common source current q=1.602176634e-19 C

full_Jv.norm: L2 with fixed test-point physical diagonal row scaling

full_Jv.zero_norm_rule: At exact zero, norm directional derivative is norm(direction); AD zero is only an explicit generalized-derivative convention.

finite_Newton.scope: Finite diagnostic Newton direction and fixed-scale Armijo check; not a production stopping-rule change or convergence certificate.

native_circuit_forcing: delta_b=0.01V/(1e7 ohm um * native_current_reference); current reference retains native q=1.602192e-19 C
limitations: Zero-bias source relative L2 discrepancy 16.72%, absolute Linf 8.08e-29 A/um; not qualified.

Native vs candidate first updates differ ~0.8mV; full operators are not equal.
